meaning: The Crab Nebula from afar: each dataset's prepared impostor view of this bank seen from the Sun, laid on one plane fixed in the bank's frame, through its centre and across the line of sight from Earth. From Earth the plane shows the view the volume was drawn as; from elsewhere it turns and foreshortens as a fixed object, where a camera-facing billboard of the same view spun as the camera orbited. It is a presentation of the volume, not a measurement.
